title: A Win Near Home: Nabs Another Top Workplaces Award
summary: MicroHealth earns WTOP News Top Workplaces award, joining 121 Greater Washington organizations honored for outstanding community workplace.
body_markdown:
By **Morgan Dingle** | Jun 22, 2026


Estimated reading time:


3


minutes


### Recognition Among Greater Washington’s Best Employers


Vienna, Virginia – MicroHealth LLC has been named a 2026 WTOP News Top Workplaces winner, joining an elite group of only 121 organizations with 150-499 employees recognized across the Greater Washington area. This prestigious honor celebrates companies that have built outstanding, employee-driven workplace cultures in one of the nation’s most competitive talent markets.


#### What Makes This Recognition Special


The WTOP News Top Workplaces award stands apart because it’s entirely driven by employee voice. Unlike many workplace awards that rely on company submissions or external metrics, this program, coupled with Energage, recognizes organizations based exclusively on anonymous employee feedback. Team members evaluate their experience across critical dimensions including workplace culture, trust in leadership, benefits, and overall employee experiences.


For MicroHealth to earn this distinction means our employees have spoken—and their message is clear: this is a place where people want to work, grow, and contribute to meaningful missions.


#### The Numbers Tell the Story


Being selected from the Greater Washington area’s vast employer landscape is no small achievement. The region is home to thousands of companies competing for top talent, yet only 121 organizations in the 150-499 employee category earned recognition this year. MicroHealth’s inclusion in this select group validates what we’ve built: a workplace culture that prioritizes people while delivering mission-critical results.


#### What Our Team Values Most


The anonymous feedback that earned MicroHealth this recognition highlights several key strengths:


**Trust in Leadership:** Our veteran-led approach creates an environment where transparency, accountability, and mission focus drive decision-making. Employees consistently report confidence in leadership’s direction and commitment to the team.


**Meaningful Benefits:** MicroHealth supports its workforce with comprehensive benefits including health coverage, 401(k) matching up to 5%, tuition assistance, professional development through MicroHealth University, hybrid work flexibility, and unique wellness amenities like an on-site gym and dedicated relaxation spaces.


**Employee Experience:** From onboarding through career advancement, MicroHealth invests in creating an environment where people can do their best work. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, innovation, and the kind of mission focus that comes naturally to a veteran-owned organization.


#### Looking Forward


As MicroHealth continues to grow and take on increasingly complex federal IT challenges, maintaining this exceptional workplace culture remains a top priority. The company’s leadership understands that delivering mission-critical solutions for federal agencies, healthcare systems, and defense operations requires more than technical expertise—it requires a team that’s engaged, supported, and committed to excellence.


The 2026 WTOP News Top Workplaces recognition confirms that MicroHealth has built exactly that kind of team.
